measurement_note: Size is both the number of active orders inserted and the number of subsequent lookups for an absent (orderType, price) pair. Each tier uses 2 * size method calls, within the 2,000-call limit. Direct bucket access is O(size), while scanning every active order for every lookup is O(size^2).
